llm.training_status: NOT TRAINED: separately installed local model weights are not fine-tuned by knowledge ingestion

cnn_rnn.cnn_training_status: NOT TRAINED: no separately labelled, licensed CNN task dataset supplied
cnn_rnn.rnn_training_status: trained during ISO build from the versioned knowledge database; report/evaluation metadata stored with weights

training_policy: The small advisory RNN is trained and evaluated during ISO image staging from the versioned knowledge database; no runtime weight updates occur. CNN training requires a separately selected, labelled and licensed task dataset. LLM chat uses local inference with retrieved evidence and does not fine-tune LLM weights.
release_boundary: Runtime probes, indexing and local inference availability do not establish Koronos userspace readiness.

rnn.training: small character-level RNN trained during ISO build from curated knowledge entries
rnn.role: advisory text-pattern component; not authoritative and not an LLM
rnn.score_semantics: mean next-character log probability; advisory diagnostic only
